dedupe_keys.name: ptv lines public transport service planning software

description: PTV Lines is PTV Group's cloud software for public transport service planning and timetable optimisation, built for transit planners. The product page says planners can create and adjust timetables, routes and service proposals within minutes for bus and rail networks. Recent features include occupancy calculations that connect ridership with vehicle capacity to reveal overcrowded or underused services through the day, line separation tools that offset lines sharing a corridor, and demand and ridership analysis showing where, when and how many passengers use services. Coverage: bus and rail networks of any agency. Format and access: a hosted application; the page invites users to request a free demo. Licence and cost: proprietary and paid. Caveats: the page gives no data formats or prices. It supports capacity planning and network flow analysis of transit services. It relates to PTV Visum, Remix and Optibus in the catalogue.
